structure.note: At 31 December 2025 Roche had 106,691,000 bearer shares, which carry the votes, and 702,562,700 non-voting equity securities (Genussscheine), which conferred no votes but shared equally in profits and liquidation proceeds. A shareholder group with pooled voting rights (members of the Hoffmann and Oeri founding families; pooling agreement in place since 1948) owned 69,318,000 shares, or 64.97% of the issued (voting) shares. Maja Oeri and Melchior Oeri, outside the pool, each held 4,045,950 shares (3.79% of issued shares). All these percentages are of the bearer shares only, not of all equity securities, so none is listed as an economic holder here. On 10 March 2026 the AGM approved exchanging the non-voting equity securities one-for-one for listed non-voting participation certificates (Partizipationsscheine) with the same dividend and liquidation rights (Half-Year Report 2026).

notes: All figures from Roche's own Annual Report 2025 and Finance Report 2025 PDFs on assets.roche.com (linked from roche.com/investors/annualreport25), fiscal year ended 31 December 2025, CHF converted exactly from CHF millions. OWNERSHIP: Severin Schwan (Chairman, former CEO) held 265,962 bearer shares and 91,693 non-voting equity securities (NES) at 31 December 2025; no percentage is given, so pctEconomic is null (for reference only, 357,655 of 809,253,700 equity securities is about 0.04%; not disclosed). shares records the bearer shares only. FOUNDING-FAMILY POOL: the 64.97% held by the shareholder group with pooled voting rights is a percentage of the 106,691,000 issued bearer shares, i.e. a share of the votes, not of all equity. The NES (702,562,700) carried the same economic rights as shares but no votes, so the pool's economic share of all equity securities is far lower; the report does not state it, so it is not derived or recorded. The pool is not Schwan's holding (he is not a member), so it is not placed in leader.family. Maja Oeri's and Melchior Oeri's 3.79% each (Maja Oeri held 7.58% a year earlier) are on the same bearer-share basis. 'controlled: true' rests on the pool's 64.97% of voting shares. No other holders are disclosed, so largestHolders is empty. The company keeps no share register (bearer shares). CAPITAL STRUCTURE (after the year end): on 10 March 2026 the AGM approved replacing the NES with participation certificates of CHF 0.001 nominal value, listed on SIX from 17 March 2026 with the same dividend and liquidation rights as the bearer shares, and cut the bearer shares' nominal value from CHF 1.00 to CHF 0.001 (repaying CHF 0.999 per share). DIVIDENDS: CHF 7,731m to Roche shareholders; the cash-flow total of CHF (8,385)m also includes CHF 647m to Chugai minorities and CHF 8m to other minorities, excluded. BUYBACKS: 0 under the site's rule that purchases covering employee plans are not cash returned to shareholders. Roche ran no buyback programme in 2025 and Roche Holding Ltd itself 'neither purchased nor sold' shares or NES. Group companies had a net cash outflow of CHF 960m from 'Transactions in own equity' (Note 27), which the report says mainly relates to equity instruments held for equity compensation plan obligations; it sits in the cash-flow line 'Equity-settled equity compensation plans, net of transactions in own equity (987)'. To count it instead, use 0.96 (net). STOCK COMP: CHF 857m equity compensation plan expense. GEOGRAPHY: the Sales column only (CHF 61,516m), which excludes CHF 1,840m of other revenue (royalties etc.); from 2025 the report shows China separately from Rest of Asia.
